verdict.rationale: Cake documents digital certificate issuance permanently tied to cap table entries (docs-22, docs-33, docs-23) and supports two certificate types plus linking of externally issued certificates, and separately advertises in-platform digital/e-signing for approvals and raises (docs-7, docs-10). However, no evidence explicitly confirms that share certificates themselves are e-signed as legally binding documents within the platform, only that e-signing exists elsewhere in workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that certificate issuance itself includes a legal e-signature step, and independent/hands-on confirmation of legal enforceability.
